# Engin3D Metadata Microservice Skill

Use this skill whenever the task concerns the Engin3D Metadata microservice.

## Layers 

### Engin3D Metadata

The dedicated Metadata (presentation layer - REST) project is in  `src/server/metadata/Engin3D.Metadata`

### Engin3D Metadata Application

The dedicated Metadata Application layer project is in `src/server/metadata/Engin3D.Metadata.Application` 

### Engin3D Metadata Composition

The dedicated Metadata Composition layer (DI) project is in `src/server/metadata/Engin3D.Metadata.Composition` 


### Engin3D Metadata Domain

The dedicated Metadata Domain layer project is in `src/server/metadata/Engin3D.Metadata.Domain` 


### Engin3D Metadata Infrastructure

The dedicated Metadata Infrastructure layer project is in `src/server/metadata/Engin3D.Metadata.Infrastructure`
